{{Quote|The Sith grew past the use of lightsabers. But we continue to use them, if only to humiliate the Jedi.|Darth Sidious|<ref name="TRODV">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>}}
'''Darth Sidious' lightsabers''' were two [[Sith lightsaber/Legends|Sith lightsabers]] created by [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], also known as the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], Darth Sidious.

==Specifications==
[[File:Palpatineyouth.jpg|thumb|left|225px|Darth Sidious wielding his first lightsaber during his training under Darth Plagueis.]]
Being a patron of the arts, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] designed his original weapon with a high level of craftsmanship, clearly influenced by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] love of antiquity. The body of the lightsaber was fashioned from nigh-indestructible [[Phrik/Legends|phrik alloy]] while the flat emitter was composed of [[Aurodium/Legends|aurodium]].<ref name="RotSvd" /> The whole of the weapon possessed a refined and elegant [[Electrum/Legends|electrum]] finish. The weapon utilized a [[Synthetic lightsaber crystal/Legends|synthetic crystal]] as the focusing crystal.<ref name="SW:Lightsabers" />

Ever the pragmatist, Sidious already had prepared a backup lightsaber. This weapon was initially identical to his first lightsaber with the electrum and phrik finish of his original weapon,<ref name="The Lawless">{{TCW|The Lawless}}</ref> but it was later retrofitted with an unknown black alloy.<ref name="RotS" />

In truth, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] normally wielded enough powers to fight without a lightsaber, but every [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] still learned to use one as part of his or her training.<ref name="SWSW">''[[Star Wars: Sith Wars]]''</ref> Sidious himself felt that he and his peers had outgrown the use of lightsabers, and only continued carrying them to mock the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. He claimed that he ultimately viewed his own lightsabers as little more than an affectation, and rarely wielded them in combat.<ref name="TRODV" /> However, almost invariably when faced with his most dangerous opponents such as Maul and Savage,<ref name="The Lawless" /> Windu and other Jedi, Grandmaster Yoda,<ref name="RotS" /> or Marek;<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' {{C|Wii, PS2, PSP, and DS versions}}</ref> he used the lightsaber as his tool of vital defense against the otherwise-fatal blows he faced and to attack his enemies.<ref name="RotS" />

==History==
===Creation and early usage===
{{Quote|Within a long, slim, rod-shaped cavity around which the sculpture had been forged rested a device that had lain, waiting, in absolute darkness - darkness beyond darkness - for decades.|Palpatine's thoughts while retrieving his lightsaber|<ref name="RotSn">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>}}
[[File:Lightsaberinhiding.png|thumb|225px|Palpatine concealed his lightsaber in a statue of Sistros.]]
Darth Sidious created his first lightsaber during his apprenticeship, and used this weapon throughout his [[Sith training]] under [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> When he began his political career,<ref name="RotSn" /> he concealed this lightsaber within a [[Neuranium/Legends|neuranium]] statue of [[Sistros/Legends|Sistros]],<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> having the piece fabricated around his lightsaber. The weapon remained hidden within the statue for decades, waiting until Sidious needed it.<ref name="RotSn" /> During this period, the Sith Lord was forced to use back-up weapons when he needed to wield a lightsaber. On [[Massacre at the Gran Protectorate Embassy|one occasion]], he even needed to wield his [[Darth Plagueis's lightsaber|Master's lightsaber]] instead of his own weapon.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> At another point, he created a second lightsaber as a backup weapon.<ref name="RotSn" /> Sidious [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] his apprentice [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] as part of Maul's training.<ref name="Restraint">{{StoryCite|story=Restraint|book=Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter}}</ref><ref name="Wrath">''[[The Wrath of Darth Maul]]''</ref>

===Clone Wars===
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Fact File 44">[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 44|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 44]]</ref><ref name="Fact File 102">[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 102|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 102]]</ref> Darth Sidious used his lightsabers on three occasions during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="The Lawless" /><ref name="Sacrifice" /><ref name="Son of Dathomir 4">[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 4|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 4]]</ref>

====Mandalore====
[[File:Darth_Sidious_Mandalore.png|thumb|left|250px|Darth Sidious wielding both weapons on Mandalore]]
When Darth Sidious learned that his former apprentice Darth Maul was alive following a twelve-year exile and was on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] with his brother [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] having conquered the planet, Sidious took his two lightsabers with him and traveled to the [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|Sundari Royal Palace]] in his personal shuttle and confronted the two [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] brothers. After exchanging brief words with Maul, he pulled out and used two lightsabers to combat the two. He used erratic, but fluent, movements during the duel, even going out of his way to cut up the floor of the palace.<ref name="The Lawless />

Sidious proved to be too strong for them and although he was unable to defeat the brothers quickly, he was ultimately able to separate them from each other. When Opress recovered from a kick he received from Sidious, Sidious at first sidestepped Opress's movements with little effort without his lightsaber active before he activated his lightsabers and engaged Maul's brother. He proceeded to completely outmatch Opress and soon [[Shiak|impaled]] the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrother]] with his lightsabers, killing him.<ref name="Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy">''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]''</ref> Sidious - again exchanging brief words - leapt down with both lightsabers and continued to duel Maul with fearsome ferocity. Although Maul put up a far more ferocious fight, Sidious ultimately disarmed the Zabrak Sith Lord and then he put his lightsabers away in the folds of his robes having won the duel and incapacitating Maul.<ref name="The Lawless" />

====Moraband====
On [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Darth Sidious planned to attack [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] (who was then on [[Korriban/Legends|Moraband]]) with [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith sorcery]]; he used his second apprentice [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus's]] relationship to the elderly Jedi Master to his advantage in order to do so. With a drop of Tyranus's blood, Sidious created an [[Dark illusion/Legends|illusion]] fed by [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] of both Sith Lords. After failing to fool Yoda with an illusion of [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]], Sidious formed a second illusion where Yoda was aboard a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Republic gunship]] bound for [[The Works/Legends|The Works]] district of Coruscant. After [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] engaged Tyranus in a lightsaber duel in which the elderly Sith apprentice fell (foreshadowing his actual demise at Skywalker's hands), Yoda and Sidious dueled on an outdoor walkway, each brandishing a lightsaber. Although Sidious fought Yoda evenly, he used Force lightning to incapacitate Anakin. Sidious continued to fight Yoda as things took a turn for the worse when Anakin's unconscious body began to fall off the walkway destroyed by Sidious. Despite Sidious's taunting use of Dun Moch, Yoda used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to prevent the young [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] from falling (despite being an eventual threat), willing to sacrifice everything, including himself, in order to save his friend. Yoda and Sidious fell to the ground below and the former found himself holding nothing but the Sith Lord's empty robes. His final trial complete, Yoda awoke from his nightmarish vision and returned to Coruscant.<ref name="Sacrifice">{{TCW|Sacrifice (episode)}}</ref>

====Dathomir====
[[File:Maul-confronts-Sidious-and-Grievous.png|thumb|right|250px|Sidious using one of his lightsabers on Dathomir]]
On Dathomir, Darth Sidious wielded one of his lightsabers in a confrontation against his former apprentice Darth Maul. Sidious fought against Dooku, who had been possessed by Mother Talzin, and managed to free Dooku from her control by blasting him with force lightning.<ref name="Son of Dathomir 4" />


===The Galactic Empire's rise===
====Showdown on Coruscant====
[[File:VERY_NASTY.png|thumb|left|200px|Darth Sidious brandishing his original lightsaber against the Jedi.]]
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Palpatine revealed to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] that he was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]].<ref name="RotS" /> As [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and his Jedi entourage rushed to the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Senate Office Building]] to [[Showdown on Coruscant|confront]] him, Palpatine retrieved his lightsaber in advance, so as not to be unarmed when they arrived. He retrieved it [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] by igniting it within the statue and seizing it once it burned its way out. Hiding the weapon within his sleeve, Palpatine awaited the Jedi. After a quick dialogue for the benefit of an audio recording device hidden in his office,<ref name="RotSn" /> the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] brandished the weapon. With a cry, the Sith Lord leapt at the Jedi, cutting down [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]] and [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]]. After Sidious killed [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], the Showdown on Coruscant became a one-on-one duel between Sidious and Windu.<ref name="RotS" />

Gaining the early advantage, Sidious gained ground on Windu. However, Windu's [[Form VII/Legends|Vaapad technique]] allowed him to counter the Sith Lord's rage-fueled frenzy. The Jedi guided the battle towards the bay window of Palpatine's office and out onto the wind-blown ledge outside. The precarious position of the battle prompted Sidious to channel some of his power into a Force-grip on the [[Permacrete/Legends|permacrete]], marginally decreasing his speed.<ref name="RotSn" /> Windu briskly disarmed the Sith Lord with a surgically precise kick to the face, throwing Sidious off-balance and causing the Sith Lord to drop his lightsaber as he flailed for purchase. The lightsaber fell out the window into the bottomless streets and alleyways of Coruscant below just before Skywalker showed up.<ref name="RotS" /> Consequently, it also forced him to only rely on one lightsaber.<ref name="Lawless trivia gallery">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep516|text="The Lawless" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>

====Showdown in the Senate====
[[File:Clash_of_Titans.png|thumb|right|250px|Darth Sidious wielding his backup/second lightsaber against Yoda.]]
{{Quote|From the shadow of a black wing, a small weapon - a hold-out, an easily concealed backup, a tiny bit of treachery expressing the core of Sith mastery - slid into a withered hand and spat a flame-colored blade of its own.|Palpatine brandishing his backup lightsaber|<ref name="RotSn" />}}
Like his first weapon, Sidious concealed this lightsaber up his sleeve. When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] [[Skirmish in the Senate|confronted]] him in the aftermath of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], Sidious brandished the weapon. During their lightsaber duel, they were seemingly matched in combat,<ref name="RotS" /> until Yoda dislodged Sidious's lightsaber out of his grip. Outmatched,<ref name="ROTS Jr">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (junior novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' junior novelization]]</ref> the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] assaulted Yoda telekinetically. Leaping onto one of the delegation pods in the Senate arena, Sidious attempted to inundate the Jedi Master by hurling several pods with the Force. Ultimately, the ferocious duel ended when Yoda was able to counter Sidious's telekinetic assault and force him to close range, causing the Sith Lord to use Force Lightning to disarm Yoda of his lightsaber only for Yoda to ultimately redirect it back after a tremendous struggle. The resulting blast separated Sidious from Yoda and the diminutive master chose to retreat.<ref name="RotS" />

====Later uses====
When his third apprentice [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] went about constructing [[Darth Vader's lightsaber/Legends|his own lightsaber]], Palpatine provided his elegant weapon as a model, as well as the synth-crystal that powered Vader's weapon. Vader regarded Palpatine's lightsaber as little more than an antique, and while respectful of its high level of craftsmanship, he preferred a weapon with more ballast. Vader's resulting weapon was little more than an enlarged version of [[Anakin Skywalker's first lightsaber/Legends|his first Jedi lightsaber]], machined out of a black alloy.<ref name="TRODV" />

Palpatine carried the lightsaber for a great deal of his life afterward, though he only rarely wielded it in combat, as his position as Emperor made battles with other Force-users few and far between, and he preferred to rely on his raw ability with the Force in any case.<ref name="Dark Empire">''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]''</ref> Palpatine used his lightsaber to strike down a group of captured Jedi, who he had armed in hopes that they would attack him.<ref name="A Spark Remains 3">''[[Dark Times—A Spark Remains 3]]''</ref> Notably, he did brandish his lightsaber during the rebellion of the [[Sa Cuis]] [[Cuis clone|clones]], though he never actually used it, as Vader dealt with the uprising himself.<ref name="ATES">{{InsiderCite|85|A Two-Edged Sword}}</ref>


====Stolen====
[[File:Kotapalpatine.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Rahm Kota wielding the lightsaber against Palpatine.]]
When [[Galen Marek]] confronted him and Darth Vader in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] with the intention of rescuing the recently captured Rebel leaders, Palpatine sat back and allowed Vader to confront the Force-adept. When Marek bested the cyborg, Palpatine began appealing to him to slay Vader and replace him as his apprentice. As Marek mulled over the idea, captured Jedi and Rebel leader [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] sprang into action. Telekinetically seizing Palpatine's lightsaber, Kota killed the guards holding him and leapt at Palpatine.<ref name="TFUn">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref>

Palpatine brought Kota down with a blast of Force lightning. However, Kota's actions prompted Marek to attack the Emperor rather than Vader, during which Palpatine fought his assailant with both the power of the dark side and his recently recovered lightsaber at hand.<ref name="TFU" /> This weapon would ultimately survive for over a hundred more years, and by the time of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]], it was an object the [[One Sith]] wished to claim.<ref name="Legacy Era Campaign Guide">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

===Replacement===
{{Main|Palpatine's blue-bladed lightsaber}}
[[File:L_versus_s.jpg|thumb|283x283px|Palpatine using a blue-bladed lightsaber to fight Luke]]
By [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], the resurrected Palpatine kept a number of stolen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] in his lab on the Imperial throne-world of [[Byss/Legends|Byss]], [[Palpatine's blue-bladed lightsaber|one of which had a blue blade]]. Palpatine used this blue-bladed lightsaber to duel [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], first [[Duel on Byss|on Byss]],<ref name="DE5" /> then [[Battle of Pinnacle Base|later]] on board his [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Eclipse (Eclipse-class)|''Eclipse'']], where it was ultimately destroyed along with the ship.<ref name="DE6">[[Dark Empire 6|''Dark Empire'' 6]]</ref>
